Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell…
and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.
Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over…
The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into…
How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt…
I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.
Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

translations.web: There went up with him both chariots and horsemen. It was a very great company.
translations.bsb: Chariots and horsemen alike went up with him, and it was an exceedingly large procession.
